title: Record Equality Indices
statement: For each natural number $k$, define an index type with four kinds of indices: comparison indices carrying $j\in\{0,\ldots,k+2\}$; forward indices carrying $j\in\{0,\ldots,k+1\}$ and $i\in\{0,1\}$; backward indices carrying a Boolean $b$, such a $j$, and such an $i$; and verdict indices carrying a Boolean.
